title: Freeze authentication and artifact-transfer contracts
description:
Purpose: Freeze the shared interfaces and rollout boundaries before parallel implementation begins.

Authentication contract:
- Public commands are plexus login, plexus whoami, and plexus logout.
- Interactive authentication uses Cognito authorization-code flow with PKCE and operating-system keychain storage.
- Access tokens refresh automatically through a single token-provider interface.
- GraphQL authentication modes are explicit Cognito for humans and IAM for workloads.
- Expired authentication directs users to plexus login and never falls back to AWS SSO or an API key.

Artifact ticket contract:
- createArtifactTransferTickets accepts one to twenty READ or WRITE requests.
- Each request includes resource type, resource ID, artifact type, filename, content type, size in bytes, and SHA-256.
- Each response includes canonical object key, HTTP method, signed URL, required headers, and expiration.
- URLs expire after five minutes and writes are limited to 100 MiB.
- Bucket and object paths are derived server-side.
- GraphQLArtifactStore retries once only for URL expiration and fails closed for authorization, transfer, or checksum errors.
- Metadata retains _s3_key compatibility and adds checksum, size, and content type.

Rollout contract: Deploy additive authentication and ticket support before migrating local storage consumers.

Definition of Done:
- All story and task IDs are linked from the parent epic.
- Dependencies and lane ownership boundaries are recorded.
- Kanbus validation passes.
- No client-specific information is present.
